title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 DEAI Hitachi Vantara
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 R0136284
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable
 **Solutions Engineer** 
 to bridge the gap between complex cloud infrastructure technologies and real\-world customer solutions. In this role, you will design, build, and implementation\-test cutting\-edge platform architectures that blend traditional virtualization with modern cloud\-native ecosystems.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering teams and enterprise customers to architect, automate, and deploy resilient infrastructure stacks across bare\-metal, virtualized, and containerized environments.
   

  

**The Role**
**Architecture \& Deployment:** 
 Design and implement robust infrastructure solutions leveraging both container orchestration (Kubernetes) and traditional cloud computing platforms (OpenStack).
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** 
 Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of complex environments using Terraform and Ansible to ensure repeatable, error\-free deployments.
   

  

**Hybrid Virtualization:** 
 Bridge the gap between legacy VMs and modern containers by deploying and managing KVM and Kube\-virt solutions.
   

  

**Automation \& Scripting:** 
 Write clean, maintainable Python and Bash scripts to automate routine tasks, build internal tools, and integrate disparate systems.
   

  

**Infrastructure Management:** 
 Optimize and troubleshoot core compute resources, storage architectures, and networking layers to ensure high availability and performance.
   

  

**Technical Consultation:** 
 Act as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders, translating complex infrastructure requirements into scalable engineering designs.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Containerization \& Virtualization
   

  

**Kubernetes:** 
 Deep, production\-grade experience with K8s orchestration, architecture, and ecosystem tools.
   

  

**OpenStack:** 
 Proven track record of deploying, configuring, and managing OpenStack components.
   

  

**KVM \& Kube\-virt:** 
 Strong understanding of kernel\-based virtual machines (KVM) and experience running traditional virtual machines inside Kubernetes clusters using Kube\-virt.
   

  

 Automation \& IaC
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Proficiency in
 **Python** 
 and
 **Bash** 
 for system automation and tool development.
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Hands\-on experience with
 **Terraform** 
 (for provisioning) and
 **Ansible** 
 (for configuration management).
   

  

 Core Infrastructure
   

  

**Compute:** 
 In\-depth knowledge of physical/virtual compute resource management and optimization.
   

  

**Storage:** 
 Strong understanding of storage technologies, including
 **Storage Area Networks (SAN)** 
 and
 **local disk technologies** 
 (NVMe, SSD, RAID configurations).
   

  

**Networking:** 
 Solid foundation in networking concepts, specifically
 **Layer 2 (L2\)** 
 and
 **Layer 3 (L3\)** 
 protocols, switching, routing, and software\-defined networking (SDN).
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Relevant certifications (e.g., CKA/CKAD, OpenStack Professional, AWS/GCP/Azure Architect).
   

  

 Experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Pre\-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services).
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex, distributed systems.
   

  

**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

 We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist**
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
 **Work Arrangement:** 
 Hybrid – 3 days per week in office
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist** 
 , you will play a key role in assessing and executing remediation of security vulnerabilities across Hyland's internal infrastructure. Working within established frameworks, you will independently carry out patching, configuration changes, and mitigation activities across servers, networks, and endpoint systems. You will collaborate closely with Infrastructure and Cyber Security teams to understand vulnerability prioritization and drive timely, accurate remediation outcomes.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities – Here's What You'll Do**
* Review and assess vulnerability findings from Cyber Security and threat detection tools to understand risk context, criticality, and determine appropriate remediation approaches within established guidelines
* Independently execute remediation activities — including patching, configuration changes, upgrades, and mitigation controls — across servers, endpoints, and network devices following established procedures
* Maintain and enhance existing automation scripts and tools for patch deployment, configuration enforcement, and validation checks with guidance from senior team members
* Collaborate effectively with Infrastructure, Support, and Engineering teams to coordinate remediation activities and communicate clear status updates on assigned work
* Monitor and manage vulnerability remediation queues, track SLAs, and ensure accurate documentation and reporting for assigned systems and platforms
* Provide input into team processes and standards; assist in mentoring new team members on remediation procedures and documentation requirements


**Role Essentials – What You'll Need**
* Experience in security vulnerability assessment and remediation across servers, endpoints, and network devices
* Demonstrated ability to independently execute patching, configuration changes, and mitigation controls following established procedures
* Experience maintaining and enhancing automation scripts for patch deployment and configuration enforcement
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across Infrastructure, Support, and Engineering teams
* Experience monitoring vulnerability remediation queues, tracking SLAs, and maintaining accurate documentation and reporting


**What We'd Like to See – Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Cyber Security threat detection tools and vulnerability prioritization frameworks
* Experience working with scripting languages for automation and configuration enforcement
* Understanding of network devices, endpoint systems, and server infrastructure
* Ability to contribute to team processes and standards, including supporting the onboarding and mentoring of new team members
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple remediation tasks simultaneously across platforms


**About Hyland**
 Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. © Hyland. All rights reserved.
   

  

 Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com .
   

  

**\#HylandLife**

Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.
   

  

 The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. We thrive on diverse viewpoints and new ideas and believe that a positive, inclusive workplace is imperative to sustainable success.
   

  

 As we've grown to a company of nearly 4,000 strong, we have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our communities . We strongly support employee initiatives and align our giving campaigns and programs to organizations that are important to them.

title: Tech S and T-Network Engineer Senior-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevSecOps \& AI Engineer**
**Job Description**
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and CircleCI for application, data, and AI workloads.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines using Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Trivy, Anchore, and OWASP tools for continuous security scanning.
* Implement shift\-left security with secret scanning (GitLeaks, TruffleHog), SBOM automation (Syft, CycloneDX), and dependency management (Dependabot, Renovate).
* Work with containerization (Docker/Podman) and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) including Helm/Kustomize for deployments and secure image pipelines.
* Develop and automate MLOps workflows using MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, SageMaker, or Vertex AI for model training, packaging, and deployment.
* Build and maintain RAG/AI integration pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Implement AI inference systems using Seldon Core, KServe, BentoML, Ray Serve, or Triton Inference Server for scalable model serving.
* Automate ETL/ELT and data feature pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt, or Kafka/Kinesis for AI model data feeds.
* Work with IaC tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep to provision cloud and AI infrastructure.
* Implement event\-driven architectures using serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions) and messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Maintain monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Datadog, or New Relic for both app and ML workloads.
* Handle model \& data observability using tools like Evidently AI, Arize AI, WhyLabs, or Fiddler for drift, bias, and performance tracking.
* Secure cloud environments using IAM best practices (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP IAM), workload identities, and least\-privilege controls.
* Support configuration management using Ansible, Chef, or SaltStack for environment consistency and automation.
* Develop scripts in Python, Bash, or SQL for automation, data processing, validation, and orchestration of ML workflows.
* Implement API integrations for AI systems using REST, gRPC, or GraphQL for model consumption and downstream applications.
* Use GitOps tools like Argo CD or Flux for automated, secure Kubernetes deployments and progressive delivery.
* Apply AI security practices including guardrails, prompt protection, model validation, and safe inference techniques using industry tools.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards including GDPR, CCPA, and cloud security best practices.
* Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, DevOps teams, and security teams, contributing to documentation, reviews, and mentoring juniors.


**Desired Profile**
* Looking for a DevSecOps \& AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML workflows.
* Strong skills in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
* Proficient in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) with good automation mindset.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices—SAST/DAST, container scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy\-as\-code.
* Exposure to MLOps/AI integration using MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, KServe, or Seldon.
* Familiar with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and GitOps tools (Argo CD/Flux).
* Strong communication, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with ability to work cross‑functionally.


**Experience**
* 4 to 7 years


**Education**
* B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Docker/Podman, Helm, Kustomize
* CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Python, Bash, PowerShell scripting
* DevSecOps tools: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, TruffleHog
* Policy\-as\-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and SBOM tools (Syft, CycloneDX)
* MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve
* Vector DBs \& RAG stack: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger
* Configuration management: Ansible, Puppet
* GitOps: Argo CD, Flux
* Serverless: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions.
